user.title: Balter EVO / Quvii Cloud
user.description: Sign in with your cloud account (not the local device password). The door PIN is optional - without it the auth code from the cloud device list is used.

data.signalling_id: App signalling id (16 hex chars, optional)

data_description.signalling_id: Only the P2P signalling accepts nothing but client ids registered with the vendor server. Without an entry the integration uses a self-generated id - cloud login and device login work with it, the signalling does not. See "Signalisierungs-ID" in the repository README.
data_description.door_pin: Leave empty to use the auth code from the device list.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Quvii cloud server
error.invalid_signalling_id: The signalling id must be exactly 16 hex characters (0-9, a-f)
